_comment: How each jurisdiction declares the FRONT of a multi-street lot. Keyed by Zoneomics city_id. front_rule values: shortest_frontage | address_street | designated | owner_elected | all_fronts. source: 'code' = found in the municipal code (see citation), 'default' = code silent, using the shortest-frontage convention. Consumed by edge-labeling.ts via the frontRule input.

295.citation: PAMC 18.09.040(j)(4) corner-lot election (10 ft street side / 16 ft front)

359.citation: SMC 19.34 / 19.79.070 - corner lots have two front yards; longer frontage reducible to ~9 ft

148.citation: SJMC 20.30.210(A) - oversized corner lots deemed two front property lines

3892.citation: HMC 17.24.020(A) - 25 ft street-line setback on every street frontage; no front concept

2653.citation: LMC 6-566(b)(2) - principal frontage per district; secondary frontage 4 ft for Class C ADUs

3985.citation: MMC 8.68.090 - front lot line = principal street

3361.citation: OMC 17.4.8 - shorter frontage is generally the front

1498.citation: TC 17.040.020(D) - 10 ft on every street frontage of a corner lot

1508.citation: MMC 20.90.030(A)(12) - primary frontage by driveway/home orientation; remaining street frontage is the side yard

1526.citation: SMC 10.88 - owner elects the front street line with Director concurrence

1933.citation: code silent; NMC 17.06 defines street-facing side lot line as a side

1485.citation: AMC 17.52.040(F)(7) - front designated by the address street on corner/double-frontage lots

1507.citation: MPMC 16.04.405 - owner may elect the front lot line on corner lots

1515.citation: PVMC 18.04.350 - owner may elect any street parcel line as front, with town planner concurrence; flag lots: line nearest and most nearly parallel to the street

1520.citation: code silent; reversed-corner rules in SCMC 18.04.030(H)

3893.citation: County zoning Def. 80 - front lot line = the narrowest lot frontage

8903.citation: LAHMC 10-1.505(c)(2) - Planning Commission designates the 40-ft street on multi-street lots
